props.name: seedText
props.description: A headline drawn into the grid in the theme font, as `seedMaterial`. Use `\n` for a second line.

props.name: seedMaterial
props.description: What the headline is made of. Packed sand holds its shape until something touches it; sand falls at once.

props.name: materials
props.description: The materials offered in the picker, in order. `'empty'` is the eraser.

props.name: palette
props.description: Colour overrides per material, as any CSS colour — tokens, `color-mix()`. `empty` is the background.

props.name: onBrushChange
props.description: Called when the picker changes the brush.

props.name: defaultBrushSize
props.description: Uncontrolled starting brush radius, in cells.

props.name: onBrushSizeChange
props.description: Called when the slider changes the brush radius.

props.name: pour
props.description: A source that drips from the top without stopping: `true` for sand, or a material.

props.name: speed
props.description: Automaton steps per frame, 1–6. Each step moves a falling grain one cell.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: CSS pixels per cell. Smaller is finer and costs more; the grid is capped at 150,000 cells whatever this says.

props.name: paused
props.description: Controlled pause. Painting still works and shows at once; nothing moves.

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Called when the pause button toggles.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the material picker, brush slider and buttons.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the sand box.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. A height here is shared between the box and the controls.
